title: Pre-Deploy Fix — false negatives in pre-deploy-check.sh
description: Pre-deploy check blocked PM2 reload with false negatives: system commands (python3, npx) flagged as missing scripts, Invoica legacy processes flagged as errors, wrong env var name (CEO_ vs TELEGRAM_), wrong cwd resolution. Fix: skip system commands, use app cwd, Invoica processes as warnings, correct env var names.
